characters.name: Rabbi Joshua
characters.description: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Hananiah, a Jewish sage of about 60, short and slightly stout, warm tan skin, twinkling dark eyes, a round friendly face, a full grey-white beard trimmed rounded, a dark-grey cloth cap, a plain earth-brown wool robe over a cream tunic, a leather satchel on a strap across his chest, leather sandals, a simple wooden walking stick.

characters.name: Girl
characters.description: A bright little girl of about 9, slim, light olive skin, lively hazel eyes, long dark-brown hair in a single braid, a sky-blue long dress with long sleeves and a cream sash, barefoot, stands with hands on hips when she makes a point.

characters.name: Boy
characters.description: A mischievous little boy of about 7, small and wiry, sun-browned skin, big dark eyes, short messy black curls, a gap-toothed grin, an ochre-yellow knee-length tunic with a brown rope belt, bare feet, often holds a few smooth pebbles.

cover.prompt: At a dusty crossroads where a road splits into two paths among olive trees, Rabbi Joshua bends toward the Boy, who sits on a flat stone and points to both roads at once with a cheeky grin. Rabbi Joshua scratches his beard, amused and puzzled. In the distance, a walled town with green gardens on a hill. Warm late-morning light, wide composition with the fork in the road as a clear shape.

pages.prompt: Inside a study hall with low benches and scrolls, Rabbi Joshua sits on a cushion answering questions, one finger raised and a merry twinkle in his eye. Students and a few richly dressed visitors listen in admiration. Warm light from small high windows and oil lamps. Medium-wide shot, Rabbi Joshua in the center.

A wide green field of young wheat under a bright sky, with a thin trodden footpath cutting across it. Rabbi Joshua walks along the path with his stick, pleased to save time. At the edge of the field the Girl stands on the road, calling out to him with one hand raised. Bright morning light, wide shot, the narrow path leading the eye.

Rabbi Joshua stands in the middle of the trodden path, laughing heartily with one hand on his belly. The Girl, at the field's edge with hands on hips, smiles a clever smile and points down at the path made by many footprints, and at the bent wheat stalks beside it. Medium shot of the two, golden light, playful mood.

A crossroads on a dusty road where the way splits into two paths, a low milestone without any marks between them. The Boy sits cross-legged on the ground playing with pebbles, arranged in a little circle. Rabbi Joshua, traveling satchel on his chest, leans on his stick and asks him the way. Afternoon light, wide shot showing both paths disappearing into olive groves.

The Boy points with both arms in two directions at once, his face serious but his eyes sparkling. Rabbi Joshua raises his eyebrows, then steps confidently onto the first, shorter-looking path with a determined little smile. Medium shot from slightly behind the boy, both paths visible, warm afternoon light.

Rabbi Joshua stands before a town ringed by thick gardens and orchards: dense fig and pomegranate trees, high hedges and stone fences with no opening. He peers left and right, hand shading his eyes, a puzzled frown under his beard. The town's flat roofs are visible just beyond, so close yet unreachable. Late-afternoon light, wide shot with the green barrier filling the picture.

Back at the crossroads, a dusty and slightly tired Rabbi Joshua spreads his hands in mock complaint. The Boy, standing on his flat stone, grins a big gap-toothed mischievous grin, then points to the second, longer road, which leads straight to an open town gate in the distance. Warm early-evening light, medium-wide shot.

Close, tender moment: Rabbi Joshua bends down and gently kisses the top of the Boy's curly head, his eyes crinkled with delight. The Boy beams proudly, pebbles still in his hand. Behind them the road and the golden evening sky. Medium close-up, warm glowing light.

A gentle closing scene: the Boy and the Girl sit together on a low wall at the crossroads at sunset, the Boy whispering an idea and the Girl listening with a finger on her chin. Rabbi Joshua, a little way off, listens with an amused smile. Two roads curve away into soft golden hills. Wide, calm, warm framing.
